title: Silpancho
description: Silpancho is a dish from Bolivia featuring beef round, chicken egg, breadcrumbs, white rice. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used.

steps.instruction: Pat dry, then coat evenly with the listed breading or flour components; press lightly to help it adhere.
Heat the pan over medium heat, shape or spoon out portions, and fry for about 16 minutes total until golden on both sides and fully cooked.
Rinse the rice, add the listed water, stock, coconut milk and aromatics as specified, cover and cook gently for about 22 minutes until tender and the liquid absorbs.
Heat the pan over medium heat, shape or spoon out portions, and fry for about 10 minutes total until golden on both sides and fully cooked.
Arrange the fully cooked and prepared parts of the dish on plates or in the intended serving vessel, adding the listed toppings or accompaniments just before serving.
